The '''Sand dragon''' was a large, [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]]. It had a huge head with massive sharp jaws, large eyes, four thick, muscular legs and a short heavy tail with a spiked knob. A sand dragon had pink, tan and black scales. Sand dragons, as their name suggests, were suited for a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] terrain though they tended to bathe in rivers and lakes sometimes.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Procurator of Justice]] and leader of the [[Empire Reborn]] [[Hethrir]] once used a sand dragon as a guardian at his compound on his personal [[Worldcraft]]. However, one of his captives, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], used his growing [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities to communicate with the sand dragon, which he nicknamed [[Mistress Dragon]]. He then persuaded her to carry him, his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and all the captive children.
